envelope.description: The read-only decision, the completion hook and its registration

body.title: The read-only decision, the completion hook and its registration
body.summary: Add blockedBySignoff, signoffHoldsCompletion, signoffCompletionHook and registerSignoffHook, and change consultHook in team/gate.ts to pass the action and the authoring workflow to the hook (AMD-17), keeping a three-argument hook working.
acceptanceChecks: blockedBySignoff refuses a stage on the followed stage's open request, changes-requested or an unrecorded completed request, and returns null for an unlisted or grandfathered stage with no tracker call
signoffHoldsCompletion is true for a Story with a listed unsigned LLD or BUILD and for an Epic with a listed unsigned DEF or HLD, and false outside team mode
consultHook passes the action and authoring to the hook and an older three-argument hook still works
The hook returns continue for open-signoff, revise and release

tests.name: src/workflow/team/__tests__/signoff-hook.test.ts: blockedBySignoff and signoffCompletionHook on one story unit block design.story authoring on the HLD's open request and plan authoring on the LLD's open request, but not the LLD's own authoring, skip a grandfathered head, return awaiting-signoff, a changes-requested refusal, an unsettled-completed refusal, or continue, never write, and need no tracker call

src/workflow/team/__tests__/signoff-hold.test.ts: signoffHoldsCompletion is true for a Story whose listed LLD or BUILD is not signed off and for an Epic whose listed DEF or HLD is not, false for a grandfathered pre-anchor member when anchorKnown is true, true for it when anchorKnown is false, and false outside team mode, with no policy, or with no member stage listed
src/workflow/team/__tests__/signoff-registration.test.ts: consultHook passes the action and the authoring workflow to the hook and an older three-argument hook still works
